title: Principal verdicts: Acquisition, Disposition, Protection/Hedging PASS at Portfolio Mandate level
context: Pressure test of three candidates previously flagged uncertain in the working ontology table, using the Principal's decision-relevance criterion.
evidence_at_time: Principal reasoning: distinct optimization targets (ownership price; exit target; counterfactual protection).
alternatives: Acquisition demoted to an Income phase (rejected by Principal: premium chasing overrides ownership discipline)
principal_wording: A Portfolio Mandate earns its place only if it changes the decision rules and the success metric; otherwise it is just a label.
rationale: Acquisition: strike governed by 'price I'd celebrate owning'; Disposition: call-away desired, strike is exit; Protection: cost center judged counterfactually.
subsequent: §32 Muse reopened Acquisition/Disposition/Preservation (61:3928); Kiro collision: changing only declared Mandate produced no legitimate Recommendation change (61:3946); demotion explicitly not ratified (61:4190-4191).
notes: Document: 'remains a Principal survey verdict pending PL-SEM-01 falsification/reconciliation' (1515).

title: Principal Mandate-scope falsification: Program and Program-phase falsified; Capital Pool vacuous; Inventory Block circular; Decision Aspect survives
context: Where does Portfolio Mandate bind? Evidence set = §30 Principal mapping.
principal_wording: Mandate binds at decision-aspect scope: each governed decision aspect (strike selection, premium acceptance, sizing, exit targeting, etc.) is evaluated under exactly one frame, while a compound decision can contain multiple single-frame aspects.
rationale: One counterexample falsifies; unfalsified-by-re-pooling or by-construction is vacuous/circular.
expected_consequences: n-to-n Program×Mandate reinterpreted as projection; DecisionAspect a candidate concept under falsification (3037).
subsequent: §32 Muse rejects Decision-Aspect hypothesis (61:3064-3072); 'DecisionAspect should remain an unratified research concept' (61:3599); Kiro audit 'has not earned entity status' (61:4142).
amendments: Decision-Aspect part rejected: docs/61-inner-game-governed-prescriptive-decision-discipline-2026-09-24.md:3928; H1/H2 falsifications not reversed in what I saw.
notes: Count error in H1 ('Four of thirteen'), see S61B-E053.
